pillars.title: Teachers stay in charge
pillars.body: Kestrel drafts; a teacher approves anything a class sees.

pillars.title: Evidence before claims
pillars.body: Every outcome we state comes from a named study or a named district.

pillars.title: Runs on what schools already own
pillars.body: No new hardware, no new procurement round.

pillars.title: One price per school
pillars.body: Priced per school, never per pupil.
